Name: Total Luck Control
Author: AditOliSamping
Description:
[size=5][b]Total Luck Control 2.0.0[/b][/size]
[i]Take full, intuitive control over Stardew Valley's luck and RNG mechanics.[/i]

Total Luck Control gives you flexible, in-game control over daily fortune, fishing, mining, item quality, night events, garbage cans, and combat. Whether you want a subtle nudge to ladder discovery, guaranteed night events, or a customized luck experience, TLC lets you configure everything through an easy-to-use in-game menu.

[size=4][b]✨ What's New in 2.0[/b][/size]
Version 2.0 is a complete ground-up rewrite and modernization after the original 1.2 release:
[list]
[*][b]Simplified Daily Luck:[/b] Natural Stardew scale (-0.10 to +0.10) with friendly fortune teller levels ([b]Very Unlucky[/b] to [b]Very Lucky[/b]).[/*]
[*][b]Universal 0–100% Ranges:[/b] All chance and boost percentages now use an intuitive 0% to 100% scale without arbitrary caps.[/*]
[*][b]Quality Presets & Upgrade Only:[/b] Easy presets ([b]Mostly Normal[/b], [b]Mostly Silver[/b], [b]Mostly Gold[/b], [b]Mostly Iridium[/b]) or safe [b]Upgrade Only[/b] mode that never downgrades vanilla rolls.[/*]
[*][b]New GMCM Menu Layout:[/b] Categorized subpages (Fishing, Mining, Garbage, Quality, Night Events, Combat) with built-in [b]< Back to Main[/b] navigation.[/*]
[*][b]Full i18n Support:[/b] Fully localized menus and options.[/*]
[*][b]Deterministic & Safe RNG:[/b] Replaced unseeded rolls and shared luck mutations with safe, action-scoped logic that preserves vanilla roll counts and order.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic 1.2 Migration:[/b] Existing configs automatically upgrade on first launch with a safety backup created.[/*]
[/list]
---

[size=4][b]🎮 Features[/b][/size]

[size=3][b]1. Custom Daily Luck[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Set your daily base luck from [b]Very Unlucky[/b] to [b]Very Lucky[/b] (-0.10 to +0.10).[/*]
[*]Special Charm automatically stacks its normal bonus on top.[/*]
[*]Turn it off anytime to let Stardew handle daily fortune naturally.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]2. Fishing[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Bite Speed:[/b] Dedicated slider from 0% ([b]Vanilla[/b]) to 100% ([b]Fastest[/b] bite timing).[/*]
[*][b]Treasure Chests:[/b] Choose between [b]Set Base Chance[/b] (lets Stardew's normal tackle/luck bonuses apply) or [b]Set Final Chance[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Golden Treasure:[/b] Control conversion rates for eligible chests once vanilla requirements are met.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]3. Mining[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Ladders & Shafts:[/b] Adjust appearance rates with modes like [b]Add Bonus Chance[/b], [b]Multiply Vanilla Chance[/b], [b]Set Chance[/b], or [b]Always When Eligible[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Extra Drops:[/b] Set chances (0–100%) to gain an extra ore from metal nodes or bonus loot from monsters.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]4. Garbage Cans[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Boost loot chances when checking town garbage cans on a calibrated 0–100% scale.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]5. Item Quality[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Presets:[/b] Pick your preferred mix ([b]Mostly Normal[/b], [b]Mostly Silver[/b], [b]Mostly Gold[/b], [b]Mostly Iridium[/b]).[/*]
[*][b]Upgrade Only Mode:[/b] Ensures you only get equal or higher quality than vanilla rolls.[/*]
[*][b]Per-Category Toggles:[/b] Enable or disable quality rules independently for crops, wild forage, and fruit trees.[/*]
[*][b]Harvest Bonuses:[/b] Optional chance for extra harvest yield and forage spawn multipliers.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]6. Night Events[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Control individual overnight event odds for the [b]Crop Fairy[/b], [b]Witch[/b], [b]Meteorite[/b], and [b]Stone Owl[/b].[/*]
[*]Set events to [b]Vanilla[/b], [b]Multiplier[/b], [b]Set Chance[/b], or [b]Guaranteed[/b] (valid farm tile requirements still apply).[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]7. Combat[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Fine-tune critical hits with flat bonus chances, multipliers, or target percentages.[/*]
[*]Trigger attack damage boosts without altering monster defense.[/*]
[*]Add a chance to land defense-ignoring attacks.[/*]
[/list]
---

[size=4][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] 1.6+[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0+[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url][/b] (strongly recommended for configuring settings in-game)[/*]
[/list]
---

[size=4][b]📥 Installation & Updating[/b][/size]

[b]First Time Install:[/b]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download and unzip [b]TotalLuckControl[/b] into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.

[b]Updating from 1.2.0:[/b]
[list]
[*] Simply replace the old mod folder with the 2.0.0 folder.[/*]
[*]Your existing [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] migrates automatically on launch.[/*]
[*]A one-time safety backup is saved as [font=Courier New]config.pre-2.0.0.json[/font].[/*]
[*][b]No need to delete your existing config file![/b][/*]
[/list]
---

[size=4][b]🌐 Translations[/b][/size]
TLC includes full SMAPI internationalization ([font=Courier New]i18n[/font]) support.
To contribute a translation, copy [font=Courier New]i18n/default.json[/font], translate the values to your language (e.g. [font=Courier New]es.json[/font], [font=Courier New]zh.json[/font]), and submit a pull request on GitHub!

---
